drive.label: Google Drive: the backup folder and how many copies it keeps
drive.help: The folder Connect Google Drive makes in your own Drive, and how many of the newest backups that were checked whole Drive keeps (older ones go to the Drive's bin). 0 keeps them by age instead.

plan.label: The nightly backup: when, and how long each copy is kept
plan.help: The time of the nightly backup, the days the server's disk, Azure Blob and Google Drive keep (Drive by days only when its number of copies is 0), the days archived WAL stays on the disk for a restore to any minute, and the free share the backup disk keeps (the oldest copies go first, never the newest).

drill.label: The monthly restore drill
drill.help: Once a month the server restores its newest backup into a throw-away database and checks it (tables, a sample photo, the docs), never the live one; with Blob and Drive on, their copies too. The result is shown on the Backups page.

alerts.label: Telegram for backups
alerts.help: A Telegram message when a backup or a restore drill fails (recommended on), and when it went well (off: no message on a good night).

blob.label: Azure Blob: the backups' container
blob.help: The container in your Azure storage account the nightly backups and the WAL go to (the photos have their own container on the Azure Blob connection). Turn on soft delete and versioning for it in Azure.

gate.label: Backups ready for real orders
gate.help: What "ready" asks of the backups: the last copy in Blob and in Drive no older than these hours, and a restore drill of each that passed within these days.

checks.label: Go-live: how fresh the automatic checks must be
checks.help: The last smoke test of every page no older than these hours, and the server's own health check no older than these minutes, for the go-live checklist. PR 397: the Cloudflare Origin certificate must still have at least these days (30).

ownerData.label: Go-live: the owner's own data every live store needs
ownerData.help: The store settings (contact, legal …) that must be filled in for every store that goes live, and whether each needs a delivery band switched on. Only which fields; the owner types the values in Settings → Store details.

connections.label: Go-live: the connections that must be live
connections.help: The kinds of connection (payment, courier, SMS …) that need at least one connection moved from practice to live by a passing test in Keys & connections before real orders. A shop without online payment takes PAYMENT off this list.

signoff.label: Go-live: the items a person confirmed
signoff.help: Who confirmed each go-live item that a person checks (the QA gate, the staging acceptance list, real phones …) and when. Changed only on Settings → System → Go-live.
